guide.goal: 駕馭 Digital SAT 雙模組多階段適性測驗（MST）演算法；精通 Craft & Structure, Information & Ideas, Standard English, Rhetorical Synthesis 四大領域。
guide.motivation: College Board Digital SAT 官方評量標準與難度適性跳轉門檻規範。

tips.title: Digital SAT 兩階段模組化適應性測驗 (MST) 機制與算分藍圖
tips.body: Digital SAT 閱讀與寫作共 54 題、64 分鐘，分成兩個各 32 分鐘的模組。第一模組包含不同難度；第二模組的難度依第一模組表現調整。不要由進入哪個模組自行推算固定分數上限，也不要把本站練習正確率換算成官方分數。考試結構以 College Board 公告為準。
tips.example: 實戰策略：Module 1 前 15 題不容失誤，確保穩定打入 Hard Module 2！

tips.title: 四大內容領域與解題架構 (Construct Blueprint)
tips.body:
1. Craft and Structure (28%)：Words in Context 高難度語境詞彙精析（如 delineate, corroborate）、作者論證結構與修辭目的。
2. Information and Ideas (26%)：Command of Evidence 文本與數據證據定位、Inferences 邏輯完形結論推論。
3. Standard English Conventions (26%)：長句語法結構、Boundaries 標點符號、主謂一致、懸垂修飾語 (Dangling Modifiers)。
4. Expression of Ideas (20%)：修辭修訂、段落銜接過渡詞、學生研究筆記整合 (Rhetorical Synthesis)。
tips.example: 標點題秒殺法則：兩個獨立完整子句 (Independent Clauses) 之間，不可僅用逗號連接（Comma Splice 錯誤），必須使用分號 (;) 或逗號加對等連接詞 (, and)！

tips.title: 題型一・Craft & Structure: Words in Context 高階語境詞彙與修辭目的 (Contextual Nuance & Rhetorical Purpose)
tips.body:
【核心構念 (Construct Essence)】
Digital SAT 徹底拋棄死記硬背生僻詞套路，聚焦於大學學術文獻、自然科學報告、歷史文獻中「高階學術詞彙（Tier 2 Academic Words）在極度精確語境下的修辭功能與意圖辨析」。

【步驟 0 破題思維 (Step 0 Mindset)】
1. 嚴禁憑中文翻譯套入後「覺得通順」主觀猜測！Digital SAT 題幹文本極其凝練，應結合全文線索辨義，線索不一定是明示的同義詞或反義詞。
2. 尋找轉折樞紐詞：However, yet, far from, rather than, whereas 提示語意可能有對比，不代表空格必須是某個詞的字典反義詞；In addition, moreover, indeed, colon (:) 則指向空格為前句觀點的精確深化或同義置換。
3. 預測空格語意極性（+/-/中性）與詞義核心，再去四個選項中精確打擊！

【致命陷阱診斷 (Traps Diagnosis)】
• 陷阱 1：字面常見義項干擾 (Familiar Sense Trap)。例如 compromise 常見義為「妥協」，但在學術安全語境中指「危害、使受損 (undermine / jeopardize)」；table 作動詞在美式英文常指「擱置」，英式英文常指「提交討論」，須依語境判斷。
• 陷阱 2：感情色彩過度極端 (Overly Extreme Tone)。學術論述追求嚴謹客觀，非特殊修辭文本中，過度情緒化的詞彙（如 disastrous, miraculous, definitive）往往是干擾項。

【大師經典示範題精析 (Master Worked Demonstration)】
題目：Far from being a monolithic movement, modern environmentalism is characterized by ______ viewpoints, ranging from radical ecocentrism to pragmatic market-based policies.
選項：(A) homogeneous  (B) disparate  (C) dogmatic  (D) obsolete
【大師解剖】：看到句首樞紐結構「Far from being [monolithic]」（絕非單一鐵板一塊的），後文又列舉了從極端生態中心主義到實用市場政策的廣泛跨度，空格必須填入表達「多元、紛繁多樣」的精確學術詞彙。秒選 (B) disparate！(A) homogeneous 恰好反義，(C)(D) 與題幹語境無關。
tips.example: 語境詞彙破題律：空格答案必由題幹中另一個詞或句子成分嚴格保證，切勿帶入個人主觀偏好！

tips.title: 題型二・Information & Ideas: Command of Evidence & Logical Inferences 論據鎖定與完形推論 (Evidence Anchoring & Valid Conclusions)
tips.body:
【核心構念 (Construct Essence)】
包含四大高分題型：Textual Evidence（文本引文論據）、Quantitative Evidence（圖表數據論據）、Inferences（完形邏輯結論推導）、Central Idea & Details（主旨與細節）。考查從學術實證資料推導合法結論的能力。

【步驟 0 破題思維 (Step 0 Mindset)】
1. 論據支持/削弱題（Which finding, if true, would most strongly support/weaken the claim?）：
   - 第一步：迅速用括號圈出文章中研究人員的核心假說 (Hypothesis) 或主張 (Claim)，將其抽象為因果公式：自變量 X 導致 因變量 Y。
   - 第二步：審讀四個選項。若為「支持題」，選項必須證實 X 與 Y 之間的正相關/因果機制，或證明「沒有 X 則沒有 Y」，或排除潛在替代解釋；若為「削弱題」，選項必須指出異常數據 (Anomalous Evidence) 或提出變量 Z 才是導致 Y 的真因。
2. 完形推論題（Which choice most logically completes the text?）：
   - 結論必須「嚴格由已知前提推出」，不可外推跨出文章設定的邊界（嚴守 Scope of the Argument）。

【致命陷阱診斷 (Traps Diagnosis)】
• 陷阱 1：範疇漂移 (Scope Shift)。選項內容本身是客觀科學真理，但它所論述的對象超出了本實驗特定物種、特定地理區域或特定時間範疇。
• 陷阱 2：相關性誤當因果 (Correlation as Causation)。選項僅證明兩者同時發生，但題幹要求支持「前者引發後者」的機制。

【大師經典示範題精析 (Master Worked Demonstration)】
題目情境：某古生物學家假設某古代鳥類的長羽毛是用於「求偶展示」而非「飛行輔助」。問哪項發現最支持此假設？
大師解剖：支持項必須呈現求偶特異性，例如發現該羽毛僅在成熟雄性化石中出現，且其羽軸強度不足以支撐空氣動力學負荷。這能增加求偶假說的可信度、削弱飛行解釋，但不能只憑這些線索證明唯一用途。
tips.example: 圖表題黃金法則：先讀圖表標題、座標軸單位 (Units)、圖例 (Legend)，再回題幹定位數值，嚴防百分比 (Percentage) 與絕對數 (Absolute Value) 偷換！

tips.title: 題型三・Standard English Conventions: 句子邊界標點、修飾語與平行結構 (Boundaries, Modifiers & Syntactic Symmetry)
tips.body:
【核心構念 (Construct Essence)】
考查 100% 客觀的標準書面英文法規，也是 Module 1 與 Module 2 中最具「確定性秒殺」特性的高分題型。核心涵蓋：Boundaries（句界標點）、Form, Structure, and Sense（主謂一致、動詞時態語態、代名詞指涉、修飾語懸垂、對等平行結構）。

【步驟 0 破題思維 (Step 0 Mindset)】
1. 第一步：抓全句主幹！迅速挑出句子主要主詞 (Subject) 與主要限定動詞 (Finite Verb)，將所有介系詞片語、關係子句、同位語括號隔離。
2. 第二步：標點邊界三大鐵律（Punctuation Golden Rules）：
   - 鐵律 A（分號 ;）：連接子句時，兩邊須能獨立成句；分號也可分隔含逗號的複雜清單項目，並非所有分號兩側都是子句。
   - 鐵律 B（逗號加對等連接詞 , FANBOYS）：IC, and/but/so/or IC。絕不能只用逗號連接兩獨立子句（此為 Comma Splice 致命錯誤！）。
   - 鐵律 C（冒號 : 與破折號 —）：冒號前方必須是語法完整的獨立子句（Complete IC），後方可以接單字、片語或子句，用作同位解釋、列表或結果。
3. 懸垂修飾 (Dangling Modifiers) 秒殺法：句首分詞片語或介系詞片語（如 Having completed the trials, ...），逗號後面緊接的主詞必須是「完成臨床試驗的那個邏輯主體」（如 the researchers）！

【致命陷阱診斷 (Traps Diagnosis)】
• 陷阱 1：主謂遠距離阻隔 (Intervening Prepositional Phrases)。主詞與動詞之間夾雜長達 15 字的介系詞修飾，誘騙考生用最靠近動詞的複數名詞來決定動詞單複數。
• 陷阱 2：雙主詞贅肉 (Redundant Subject)。The scientist who led the expedition she discovered...（scientist 與 she 重複）。

【大師經典示範題精析 (Master Worked Demonstration)】
題目：Using laser spectroscopy to analyze ancient terracotta vessels, ______
選項：(A) significant chemical residues of cacao were detected by the archaeologists.
(B) the archaeologists detected significant chemical residues of cacao.
(C) cacao's chemical residues were significantly detected.
(D) detection of chemical residues was achieved by the archaeologists.
【大師解剖】：句首現在分詞片語 Using laser spectroscopy...，使用儀器的人必須是「考古學家 (the archaeologists)」，因此逗號後第一個字必為 the archaeologists！秒殺 (B)，排除 (A)(C)(D) 懸垂修飾錯誤！
tips.example: 標點題秒殺心法：見到選項包含「分號 (;)」與「句號 (.)」，若兩者周圍詞彙完全相同，則兩者必同時錯誤（因兩者語法功能等價）；直接在逗號與連接詞間定奪！

extra.title: 閱讀推論：答案必須有文本證據
extra.rule: 閱讀推論要選擇文本充分支持、沒有多加假設的結論，不能加入自己的背景故事。SAT、GRE、TOEFL 等閱讀練習都需要證據判斷；本頁是原創共通能力教材，不是官方試題。推論絕不可超出文本邊界：不能將 some 擴大為 all，也不能將先後順序直接等同於因果關係。
pairs: Responding to student requests for more study space, the library extended its evening hours.
直接資訊：圖書館為回應學生需求，延長晚間開放。
Students can now use the library later in the evening.
原文 Responding to 已明示回應需求；可推論學生晚間可使用圖書館的時間增加。
Every student now gets higher grades.
無法證實：沒有所有學生、成績或因果效果的資料。
extra.trap: 「延長開放後成績上升」也不能單靠先後順序證明延長開放造成成績上升；還可能有其他因素。警惕 always, never, completely 等極端絕對詞。
extra.model: 直接資訊：延長晚間開放。推論：學生晚間可使用圖書館的時間增加。未知：成績是否提升。檢查每個結論是否超出文中人數、範圍或因果。

c-intl-sat.tip1.title: Digital SAT 兩階段模組化適應性測驗 (MST) 機制與算分藍圖
c-intl-sat.tip1.body: Digital SAT 閱讀與寫作共 54 題、64 分鐘，分成兩個各 32 分鐘的模組。第一模組包含不同難度；第二模組的難度依第一模組表現調整。不要由進入哪個模組自行推算固定分數上限，也不要把本站練習正確率換算成官方分數。考試結構以 College Board 公告為準。
c-intl-sat.tip1.example: 實戰策略：Module 1 前 15 題不容失誤，確保穩定打入 Hard Module 2！

c-intl-sat.tip2.title: 四大內容領域與解題架構 (Construct Blueprint)
c-intl-sat.tip2.body: 1. Craft and Structure (28%)：Words in Context 高難度語境詞彙精析（如 delineate, corroborate）、作者論證結構與修辭目的。 2. Information and Ideas (26%)：Command of Evidence 文本與數據證據定位、Inferences 邏輯完形結論推論。 3. Standard English Conventions (26%)：長句語法結構、Boundaries 標點符號、主謂一致、懸垂修飾語 (Dangling Modifiers)。 4. Expression of Ideas (20%)…
c-intl-sat.tip2.example: 標點題秒殺法則：兩個獨立完整子句 (Independent Clauses) 之間，不可僅用逗號連接（Comma Splice 錯誤），必須使用分號 (;) 或逗號加對等連接詞 (, and)！

c-intl-sat.tip3.title: 題型一・Craft & Structure: Words in Context 高階語境詞彙與修辭目的 (Contextual Nuance & Rhetorical Purpose)
c-intl-sat.tip3.body: 【核心構念 (Construct Essence)】 Digital SAT 徹底拋棄死記硬背生僻詞套路，聚焦於大學學術文獻、自然科學報告、歷史文獻中「高階學術詞彙（Tier 2 Academic Words）在極度精確語境下的修辭功能與意圖辨析」。 【步驟 0 破題思維 (Step 0 Mindset)】 1. 嚴禁憑中文翻譯套入後「覺得通順」主觀猜測！Digital SAT 題幹文本極其凝練，應結合全文線索辨義，線索不一定是明示的同義詞或反義詞。 2. 尋找轉折樞紐詞：However, yet, far from, rather than, whereas 提示語意可能有對比，不代表空格…
c-intl-sat.tip3.example: 語境詞彙破題律：空格答案必由題幹中另一個詞或句子成分嚴格保證，切勿帶入個人主觀偏好！

c-intl-sat.tip4.title: 題型二・Information & Ideas: Command of Evidence & Logical Inferences 論據鎖定與完形推論 (Evidence Anchoring & Valid Conclusions)
c-intl-sat.tip4.body: 【核心構念 (Construct Essence)】 包含四大高分題型：Textual Evidence（文本引文論據）、Quantitative Evidence（圖表數據論據）、Inferences（完形邏輯結論推導）、Central Idea & Details（主旨與細節）。考查從學術實證資料推導合法結論的能力。 【步驟 0 破題思維 (Step 0 Mindset)】 1. 論據支持/削弱題（Which finding, if true, would most strongly support/weaken the claim?）： - 第一步：迅速用括號圈出文章中研究人員的核心假…
c-intl-sat.tip4.example: 圖表題黃金法則：先讀圖表標題、座標軸單位 (Units)、圖例 (Legend)，再回題幹定位數值，嚴防百分比 (Percentage) 與絕對數 (Absolute Value) 偷換！

c-intl-sat.tip5.title: 題型三・Standard English Conventions: 句子邊界標點、修飾語與平行結構 (Boundaries, Modifiers & Syntactic Symmetry)
c-intl-sat.tip5.body: 【核心構念 (Construct Essence)】 考查 100% 客觀的標準書面英文法規，也是 Module 1 與 Module 2 中最具「確定性秒殺」特性的高分題型。核心涵蓋：Boundaries（句界標點）、Form, Structure, and Sense（主謂一致、動詞時態語態、代名詞指涉、修飾語懸垂、對等平行結構）。 【步驟 0 破題思維 (Step 0 Mindset)】 1. 第一步：抓全句主幹！迅速挑出句子主要主詞 (Subject) 與主要限定動詞 (Finite Verb)，將所有介系詞片語、關係子句、同位語括號隔離。 2. 第二步：標點邊界三大鐵律（Punct…
c-intl-sat.tip5.example: 標點題秒殺心法：見到選項包含「分號 (;)」與「句號 (.)」，若兩者周圍詞彙完全相同，則兩者必同時錯誤（因兩者語法功能等價）；直接在逗號與連接詞間定奪！

k.reading-evidence.tip.title: 閱讀推論：答案必須有文本證據
k.reading-evidence.tip.formula: 區分直接資訊、合理推論與無法證實的猜測，破解範圍擴大與因果倒置。
k.reading-evidence.tip.body: 閱讀推論要選擇文本充分支持、沒有多加假設的結論，不能加入自己的背景故事。SAT、GRE、TOEFL 等閱讀練習都需要證據判斷；本頁是原創共通能力教材，不是官方試題。推論絕不可超出文本邊界：不能將 some 擴大為 all，也不能將先後順序直接等同於因果關係。
k.reading-evidence.tip.example: Responding to student requests for more study space, the library extended its evening hours. / Students can now use the library later in the evening.

k.reading-evidence.1.prompt: Some participants reported better sleep. Which conclusion is supported?
options: At least some participants said their sleep improved.
k.reading-evidence.1.answer: At least some participants said their sleep improved.
k.reading-evidence.1.why: some 支持至少一部分人的自陳改善。All 擴大量詞；certainly cured 擴大到確定治療效果。
k.reading-evidence.1.hint: 閱讀推論要選擇文本充分支持、沒有多加假設的結論，不能加入自己的背景故事。SAT、GRE、TOEFL 等閱讀練習都需要證據判斷；本頁是原創共通能力教材，不是官方試題。

k.reading-evidence.2.prompt: Sales rose after a new ad appeared. What can we conclude from this alone?
options: The rise happened after the ad appeared.
k.reading-evidence.2.answer: The rise happened after the ad appeared.
k.reading-evidence.2.why: 原文僅支持時間先後。因果與排除其他因素都需要額外證據。
k.reading-evidence.2.hint: 閱讀推論要選擇文本充分支持、沒有多加假設的結論，不能加入自己的背景故事。SAT、GRE、TOEFL 等閱讀練習都需要證據判斷；本頁是原創共通能力教材，不是官方試題。

d.diag-1251.prompt: While the preliminary findings seemed promising, the lead researcher urged caution, noting that the data remained ___ until verified by peer review.
d.diag-1251.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1251.why: provisional 意為「暫時的、暫定的」，精準呼應後方 until verified by peer review。 考查學術語境詞義：provisional（暫定的）。

d.diag-1252.prompt: The historian argued that the monarch's public declarations were not sincere expressions of piety, but rather ___ strategies designed to placate rebellious nobles.
d.diag-1252.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1252.why: calculated 意為「精心策劃的、預謀的」，與 sincere 形成鮮明對比。 語意對比選 calculated（精算的、有計畫的）。

d.diag-1253.prompt: Far from being a passive observer, the documentary filmmaker adopted a ___ stance, actively intervening in the socio-political debates she chronicled.
d.diag-1253.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1253.why: Far from being passive/neutral 提示反義，partisan 表示「有偏向立場的、黨派性的」。 轉折提示詞 Far from 指向反義 partisan。

d.diag-1254.prompt: The architect sought to design a structure that would not ___ upon the natural topography of the alpine sanctuary.
d.diag-1254.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1254.why: encroach upon 為固定學術搭配，意為「侵佔、蠶食、侵犯」。 固定動賓介系詞搭配選 encroach upon。

d.diag-1255.prompt: Despite the author's extensive revisions, several critics contended that the novel's thematic coherence remained ___.
d.diag-1255.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1255.why: Despite 修飾對比，修訂過但連貫性仍很 tenuous（脆弱的、薄弱的）。 轉折讓步選 tenuous（薄弱的）。

d.diag-1256.prompt: Written by a court physician who attended the emperor for decades, the newly excavated manuscript provides an ___ account of daily life in the imperial court during the late Tang dynasty.
d.diag-1256.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1256.why: intimate account 意為「近身而深入細緻的記述」。作者是長年隨侍皇帝的御醫，身分已知（排除 anonymous），且與宮廷關係親近（排除 aloof），故選 intimate。 正確答案為「intimate」。

d.diag-1257.prompt: The economist noted that excessive liquidity in the market can ___ speculative bubbles rather than foster genuine productive investment.
d.diag-1257.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1257.why: fuel speculative bubbles 為經濟學高頻動賓搭配，意為「助長推動泡沫」。 搭配詞選 fuel（助長加劇）。

d.diag-1258.prompt: Rather than maintaining a single dogmatic philosophy, the Renaissance polymath embraced an ___ approach that synthesized classical antiquity with contemporary empirical science.
d.diag-1258.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1258.why: synthesized... 提示融合各派，eclectic 意為「兼收並蓄的、多元折衷的」。 兼收並蓄各派選 eclectic。

d.diag-1259.prompt: Because the fossil specimen was heavily damaged during extraction, paleontologists found its classification highly ___.
d.diag-1259.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1259.why: heavily damaged 導致分類具有高度爭議問題，選 problematic。 原因結果邏輯選 problematic。

d.diag-1260.prompt: The soprano delivered a performance that was technically flawless yet emotionally ___, failing to move the audience.
d.diag-1260.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1260.why: yet 提示轉折：技術完美 (flawless) 但感情空洞，選 sterile。 技巧與感情反差選 sterile（枯燥冷漠的）。

d.diag-1261.prompt: Traditional economic models assume that consumers always act rationally to maximize utility; ___, empirical behavioral studies reveal that emotional biases routinely dictate financial decisions.
d.diag-1261.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1261.why: 前後分句為「古典理性假設」與「實證偏誤發現」之強烈對比轉折，選 however。 語意轉折連詞選 however。

d.diag-1262.prompt: Early cosmologists posited that the expansion rate of the universe would decelerate over time. ___, observations of distant Type Ia supernovae in 1998 proved that cosmic acceleration is actually occurring.
d.diag-1262.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1262.why: 前句假定減速，後句證實加速，構成對立轉折，選 Nonetheless。 轉折讓步過渡詞選 Nonetheless。

d.diag-1263.prompt: Some scholars argue that technological automation will cause widespread permanent unemployment; ___, others contend that it will catalyze novel industries and generate net job growth.
d.diag-1263.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1263.why: Two opposing views of scholars: conversely（相反地）。 雙邊學術對立選 conversely。

d.diag-1264.prompt: Critics claimed that the urban renewal project would displace marginalized communities. The municipality, ___, maintained that affordable housing quotas would be strictly enforced.
d.diag-1264.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1264.why: 插入語表示批評觀點與市府官方主張之轉折對立，選 however。 句中插入轉折副詞選 however。

d.diag-1265.prompt: Proponents argued that the dam would supply abundant hydroelectric energy; the environmental impact, ___, proved devastating to endemic freshwater fauna.
d.diag-1265.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1265.why: 正面利益 vs 負面生態代價之讓步轉折，選 nonetheless。 讓步轉折插入語選 nonetheless。

d.diag-1266.prompt: The government did not diminish its scientific research funding in response to the deficit. ___, it augmented the budget by fifteen percent to accelerate technological innovation.
d.diag-1266.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1266.why: 前句否定 not diminish，後句反而追加，選 On the contrary（恰恰相反）。 否定修正轉折選 On the contrary。

d.diag-1267.prompt: The ancient text was long assumed to be an astrological almanac; ___, recent paleographic analysis indicates that it served primarily as a pharmacological manual.
d.diag-1267.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1267.why: 修正長期誤解之真相轉折，選 in fact（事實上其實）。 語意修正強調選 in fact。

d.diag-1268.prompt: Skeptics derided the prototype electric vehicle as an impractical novelty. ___, the vehicle broke endurance records and ignited a global market revolution.
d.diag-1268.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1268.why: 質疑嘲諷 vs 打破紀錄之強烈轉折，選 Still。 強烈轉折副詞選 Still（然而、即便如此）。

d.diag-1269.prompt: The experimental medication caused minor fatigue in a fraction of participants; ___, its efficacy in halting tumor progression was extraordinarily pronounced.
d.diag-1269.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1269.why: 輕微副作用 vs 卓越療效之讓步轉折，選 nevertheless。 讓步轉折副詞選 nevertheless。

d.diag-1270.prompt: The committee did not sanction the proposed high-speed rail corridor. ___, it recommended redirecting infrastructural capital toward municipal bus rapid transit.
d.diag-1270.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1270.why: not sanction 之後銜接替代方案，選 Instead。 否定後替代銜接詞選 Instead。

d.diag-1271.prompt: Glacial retreat accelerated dramatically due to rising summer temperatures; ___, downstream river basins experienced catastrophic seasonal flooding.
d.diag-1271.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1271.why: 因果關係：冰川融化加速 (原因) -> 下游洪災 (結果)，選 consequently。 因果轉折副詞選 consequently。

d.diag-1272.prompt: The island nation lacks substantial fossil fuel reserves; ___, its government has invested heavily in offshore geothermal and wind infrastructure.
d.diag-1272.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1272.why: 缺乏能源儲備 -> 投資綠能，因果邏輯關係選 therefore。 因果推導詞選 therefore。

d.diag-1273.prompt: The archaeological expedition unearthed bilingual inscriptions in Greek and Aramaic; ___, epigraphers were finally able to decipher the previously obscure dialect.
d.diag-1273.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1273.why: 獲得雙語碑文 -> 專家得以破譯，選 accordingly（從而、於是乎）。 因果承接副詞選 accordingly。

d.diag-1274.prompt: The nickel-based superalloy retains its strength at extreme temperatures and strongly resists oxidation; ___, it is ideally suited for aerospace propulsion components.
d.diag-1274.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1274.why: 材料耐高溫且抗氧化（原因）-> 適合航太推進元件（結果），因果結論選 thus。 正確答案為「thus」。因果結論詞選 thus。

d.diag-1275.prompt: Agricultural runoff contaminated the regional watershed with nitrogen and phosphorus. ___, massive toxic algal blooms proliferated across the estuary.
d.diag-1275.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1275.why: 水質優養化污染 -> 藻華爆發，選 As a result。 因果關係短語選 As a result。

d.diag-1276.prompt: The newly formulated ceramic composite expands negligibly under intense thermal stress. It is, ___, considered an indispensable material for spacecraft heat shields.
d.diag-1276.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1276.why: 耐熱膨脹特性（原因）-> 獲選為防熱罩材料（結果），因果插入語選 therefore；句中插入時 therefore 比 hence 自然。 正確答案為「therefore」。

d.diag-1277.prompt: Deforestation fragmented the contiguous forest habitat. ___, the endemic arboreal marsupials suffered severe population declines.
d.diag-1277.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1277.why: 棲地破碎化 (因) -> 族群暴跌 (果)，選 Consequently。 因果副詞選 Consequently。

d.diag-1278.prompt: The clinical trial demonstrated that the monoclonal antibody neutralizes the viral spike protein effectively; ___, regulators expedited emergency approval.
d.diag-1278.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1278.why: 試驗證實抗體有效（原因）-> 監管機關加速緊急核准（結果），因果副詞選 consequently。thereby 通常接分詞片語（如 , thereby speeding approval），不能直接引導獨立子句。 正確答案為「consequently」。

d.diag-1279.prompt: The microchip architecture eliminates redundant bus wiring; ___, overall energy dissipation decreases by thirty-five percent.
d.diag-1279.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1279.why: 消除冗餘線路 -> 進而降低耗能，選 in turn（進而、轉而）。 連鎖因果承接詞選 in turn。

d.diag-1280.prompt: The central bank exhausted all conventional interest rate cuts. ___, policymakers resorted to unconventional quantitative easing measures.
d.diag-1280.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1280.why: 傳統手段用盡 -> 採非常規手段，選 Accordingly。 因果相應副詞選 Accordingly。

d.diag-1281.prompt: The novel accurately captures the linguistic idioms of nineteenth-century London; ___, it offers profound sociological insight into Victorian class stratification.
d.diag-1281.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1281.why: 捕捉語言特色 (正面論點1) + 提供階級洞察 (正面論點2)，遞進補充選 furthermore。 遞進補充連詞選 furthermore。

d.diag-1282.prompt: The newly discovered deep-sea trench ecosystem thrives without sunlight. ___, the organisms synthesize carbohydrates via chemosynthesis driven by hydrothermal vents.
d.diag-1282.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1282.why: 對上一句「無需陽光繁衍」進行具體科學機制之闡述說明，選 Specifically。 具體闡述副詞選 Specifically。

d.diag-1283.prompt: Urban canopy cover reduces ambient temperatures through shading; ___, it mitigates air pollution by filtering particulate matter.
d.diag-1283.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1283.why: 降低氣溫 (優點1) + 減緩空污 (優點2)，追加並列選 moreover。 遞進並列副詞選 moreover。

d.diag-1284.prompt: The candidate demonstrated extensive proficiency in multivariate calculus. ___, she had published empirical econometric papers in top-tier journals.
d.diag-1284.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1284.why: 數學造詣 (優點1) + 發表頂刊 (優點2)，追加補充選 In addition。 追加並列短語選 In addition。

d.diag-1285.prompt: The migratory monarch butterflies travel thousands of miles to their overwintering grounds in Mexico. ___, they congregate in the exact same oyamel fir groves used by their ancestors.
d.diag-1285.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1285.why: 強化驚嘆細節之遞進評論副詞，選 Remarkably。 情感加強評註副詞選 Remarkably。

d.diag-1286.prompt: The museum’s retrospective highlights the sculptor’s minimalist metalworks; ___, it showcases rare preliminary graphite sketches from his early Paris period.
d.diag-1286.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1286.why: 回顧展除了金屬雕塑，另外還展出早期素描，屬追加補充關係，選 additionally。 正確答案為「additionally」。

d.diag-1287.prompt: Sustainable forestry practices prevent soil degradation; ___, they preserve the biodiversity of the underlying understory flora.
d.diag-1287.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1287.why: 防止退化 + 維護多樣性，遞進選 furthermore。 遞進關係選 furthermore。

d.diag-1288.prompt: The cognitive assessment measures abstract pattern recognition; ___, it gauges the subject’s processing speed under strict time constraints.
d.diag-1288.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1288.why: 並列衡量面向，選 likewise（同樣地）。 並列連鎖詞選 likewise。

d.diag-1289.prompt: The author does not merely describe historical events chronologically; ___, she contextualizes each milestone within broader socioeconomic currents.
d.diag-1289.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1289.why: not merely... but rather 的經典變體，選 rather（而是）。 否定修正闡述詞選 rather。

d.diag-1290.prompt: The architectural design maximizes passive solar heating. ___, south-facing floor-to-ceiling double-glazed windows trap thermal energy during winter months.
d.diag-1290.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1290.why: 對上一句「被動太陽能設計」提供具體建築構件實例，選 For instance。 舉例說明短語選 For instance。

d.diag-1291.prompt:
The student wants to emphasize a similarity between the two hominid species. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal? 
Notes:
• Homo neanderthalensis crafted complex Mousterian stone tools.
• Homo sapiens in the Upper Paleolithic fabricated intricate Aurignacian blades.
• Both species utilized pigments for symbolic ritual ornamentation.
options: While Neanderthals made Mousterian tools, Homo sapiens made Aurignacian blades.
Homo sapiens inhabited Europe during the Upper Paleolithic.
Both Homo neanderthalensis and Homo sapiens engaged in symbolic behavior through the use of ornamental pigments.

d.diag-1291.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1291.why: 修辭合成：鎖定目標 (emphasize a similarity) -> 選項含 Both species utilized pigments。 修辭綜合題：鎖定目標提示詞 Both... engaged in symbolic behavior。

d.diag-1292.prompt: The student wants to introduce the Mayan city of Tikal to an audience unfamiliar with the civilization. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?
options: Tikal's Temple IV stands over sixty-five meters high in the jungle canopy.
Excavations at Tikal revealed stelae inscribed with hieroglyphic king lists.
The decline of Tikal coincided with the broader Classic Maya collapse.
Tikal, a prominent urban center of the ancient Maya civilization in modern-day Guatemala, flourished as a major political and economic hub from 200 to 900 CE.

d.diag-1292.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1292.why: 向陌生讀者介紹整體背景：包含文明、地理位置 (Guatemala) 與繁榮時期。 背景介紹功能句首選包含身分定位之同位語定義句。

d.diag-1293.prompt: The student wants to highlight a contrast between the two geothermal power plants. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?
options: Unlike the Geysers facility, which harnesses dry steam, the Nesjavellir plant utilizes high-temperature flash steam to generate electricity.
The Geysers is located in California, whereas renewable energy is expanding globally.
Both facilities generate baseload electricity with zero carbon emissions.
The Nesjavellir plant was constructed to supply district heating to Reykjavik.
d.diag-1293.answer: Unlike the Geysers facility, which harnesses dry steam, the Nesjavellir plant utilizes high-temperature flash steam to generate electricity.
d.diag-1293.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1293.why: 修辭合成：對比 (contrast) -> Unlike A, B utilizes... 對比修辭結構選 Unlike X, Y utilizes...

d.diag-1294.prompt: The student wants to present the primary research finding of Dr. Lin’s oceanographic expedition. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?
options: Dr. Lin led a three-month research cruise aboard the RV Atlantis.
Dr. Lin’s team demonstrated that deep-sea benthic organisms rely on hydrothermal vent chemosynthesis rather than photosynthetic surface debris for nourishment.
The team deployed autonomous underwater vehicles to depths exceeding four thousand meters.
Samples of seawater were collected at twelve distinct hydrothermal sites.
d.diag-1294.answer: Dr. Lin’s team demonstrated that deep-sea benthic organisms rely on hydrothermal vent chemosynthesis rather than photosynthetic surface debris for nourishment.
d.diag-1294.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1294.why: 陳述研究發現 (research finding) -> demonstrated that... 研究發現陳述選動詞 demonstrated that...

d.diag-1295.prompt: The student wants to provide an explanation for the sudden population rebound of the Iberian lynx. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?
options: The Iberian lynx is an apex feline predator native to the Mediterranean woodland.
By 2002, fewer than one hundred individual lynxes remained in Andalusia.
Intensive captive breeding combined with the ecological restoration of rabbit prey populations catalyzed the Iberian lynx’s dramatic demographic recovery.
Conservationists released tracking collars to monitor juvenile lynx dispersal patterns.
d.diag-1295.answer: Intensive captive breeding combined with the ecological restoration of rabbit prey populations catalyzed the Iberian lynx’s dramatic demographic recovery.
d.diag-1295.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1295.why: 解釋族群復甦原因 (explanation for the rebound) -> captive breeding + ecological restoration。 解釋機制句選含因果動詞 catalyzed recovery 之選項。

d.diag-1296.prompt: The student wants to emphasize the artistic significance of Edmonia Lewis's sculpture *The Death of Cleopatra*. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?
options: Edmonia Lewis completed the monumental marble sculpture *The Death of Cleopatra* in 1876.
The sculpture was exhibited at the Centennial Exposition in Philadelphia before disappearing for decades.
Carved from white marble, the statue weighs well over a ton.
By portraying Cleopatra with unsparing realism rather than idealized serenity, Lewis challenged contemporary neoclassical conventions and cemented her reputation as a pioneering sculptor.
d.diag-1296.answer: By portraying Cleopatra with unsparing realism rather than idealized serenity, Lewis challenged contemporary neoclassical conventions and cemented her reputation as a pioneering sculptor.
d.diag-1296.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1296.why: 藝術重要性 (artistic significance) -> challenged conventions and cemented reputation。 藝術價值評論句選挑戰慣例之深入闡述。

d.diag-1297.prompt: The student wants to specify the methodological innovation introduced in Dr. Alvarez’s study. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?
options: Rather than relying on destructive radiocarbon assays, Dr. Alvarez developed a non-invasive multispectral imaging technique to analyze ancient parchment inks.
Dr. Alvarez examined twelve medieval codices housed in the Vatican Library.
The study was published in the *Journal of Cultural Heritage* in autumn 2023.
Medieval inks frequently contained iron gall and oak extracts.
d.diag-1297.answer: Rather than relying on destructive radiocarbon assays, Dr. Alvarez developed a non-invasive multispectral imaging technique to analyze ancient parchment inks.
d.diag-1297.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1297.why: 方法論創新 (methodological innovation) -> non-invasive multispectral imaging technique。 方法革新句選非破壞性技術對比之選項。

d.diag-1298.prompt: The student wants to introduce the concept of 'sonar jamming' to an audience of biology students. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?
options: Predatory bats hunt nocturnally using high-frequency echolocation calls.
Sonar jamming is an evolutionary adaptation whereby certain tiger moths emit ultrasonic clicks that disrupt the echolocation of predatory bats.
Tiger moths belong to the family Erebidae and exhibit vibrant wing pigmentation.
Ultrasound frequencies exceed twenty kilohertz, beyond human auditory perception.
d.diag-1298.answer: Sonar jamming is an evolutionary adaptation whereby certain tiger moths emit ultrasonic clicks that disrupt the echolocation of predatory bats.
d.diag-1298.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1298.why: 介紹概念要先下定義：Sonar jamming is an evolutionary adaptation whereby... 說明它是什麼、誰使用、作用為何。 正確答案為「Sonar jamming is an evolutionary adaptation whereby certain tiger moths emit ultrasonic clicks that disrupt the echolocation of predatory bats.」。其他選項只提供背景細節，沒有定義概念。

d.diag-1299.prompt: The student wants to emphasize how the author’s background influenced her literary style. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?
options: The novelist was born in Montreal in 1968 and attended McGill University.
Her debut novel received the Governor General’s Award for Fiction in 2004.
Drawing directly upon her bilingual upbringing in Montreal, the novelist infused her prose with rhythmic code-switching between French syntax and English vernacular.
She frequently lectures on modern North American diaspora narratives.
d.diag-1299.answer: Drawing directly upon her bilingual upbringing in Montreal, the novelist infused her prose with rhythmic code-switching between French syntax and English vernacular.
d.diag-1299.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1299.why: 背景影響風格 (background influenced style) -> bilingual upbringing infused prose with code-switching。 正確答案為「Drawing directly upon her bilingual upbringing in Montreal, the novelist infused her prose with rhythmic code-switching between French syntax and English vernacular.」。背景與風格連結句選 Drawing upon upbringing, infused prose with...

d.diag-1300.prompt: The student wants to contrast the surface atmospheric pressure of Mars with that of Venus. Which choice most effectively accomplishes this goal?
options: Mars has polar ice caps composed of water and frozen carbon dioxide.
Venus experiences a runaway greenhouse effect resulting in surface temperatures exceeding 450 degrees Celsius.
Planetary scientists utilize orbiter spectrometers to analyze atmospheric gases across the solar system.
While both planets possess carbon-dioxide-dominated atmospheres, Venus's surface pressure is about ninety times Earth's, whereas Mars's surface pressure is less than one percent of Earth's.
d.diag-1300.answer: While both planets possess carbon-dioxide-dominated atmospheres, Venus's surface pressure is about ninety times Earth's, whereas Mars's surface pressure is less than one percent of Earth's.
d.diag-1300.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1300.why: 目標是對比兩顆行星的地表氣壓：While both... Venus's pressure is about ninety times Earth's, whereas Mars's is less than one percent。 正確答案為「While both planets possess carbon-dioxide-dominated atmospheres, Venus's surface pressure is about ninety times Earth's, whereas Mars's surface pressure is less than one percent of Earth's.」。其他選項只描述單一行星或研究方法，沒有形成對比。

d.diag-1301.prompt: The team’s archaeological hypothesis was controversial; ___, subsequent isotopic testing of the recovered pottery sherds corroborated their chronologies.
d.diag-1301.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1301.why: 分號加逗號連接兩完整獨立子句，前句為爭議，後句為證實，轉折選 nevertheless。 標點符號與獨立子句連接：分號 + nevertheless + 逗號。

d.diag-1302.prompt: Marine biologists tracked the migratory route of the humpback ___ discovered that several breeding pods ventured unusually close to the Antarctic ice shelf.
d.diag-1302.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1302.why: 動詞 tracked 與 discovered 為同一主詞 (Marine biologists) 之並列雙謂語，無需逗號或分號分隔，選 whales and。 並列複合謂語動詞，中間無逗號直接用 and 連接。

d.diag-1303.prompt: The Renaissance fresco suffered extensive water damage over the ___ conservators utilized delicate laser ablation techniques to restore the underlying pigments.
d.diag-1303.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1303.why: 兩獨立子句需要分號隔開，副詞 consequently 之後需有逗號：; consequently,。 獨立子句連接標點標準形式：分號 + 副詞 + 逗號。

d.diag-1304.prompt: The laboratory lacked sufficient funding to purchase a cryo-electron ___ researchers relied on external university consortia to collect structural datasets.
d.diag-1304.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1304.why: 兩獨立完整子句連接，需用分號 + thus + 逗號：; thus,。 分號 + thus, 連接獨立完整子句。

d.diag-1305.prompt: The orbital observatory captured high-resolution infrared images of the stellar ___ revealed unprecedented detail regarding protoplanetary disk formation.
d.diag-1305.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1305.why: 非限定關係子句修飾前面的影像或景象，用逗號 + which，不可用 that 或分號。 非限定關係子句標點選 , which。

d.diag-1306.prompt: The ancient city walls were reinforced with mortar and kiln-fired ___ structural integrity enabled them to withstand seismic shocks for millennia.
d.diag-1306.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1306.why: 兩獨立子句（walls were reinforced... / their structural integrity enabled...）不能只用逗號連接（comma splice），也不能無標點直接相連，須用分號：bricks; their。 正確答案為「bricks; their」。

d.diag-1307.prompt: The linguistics professor analyzed the phonological shifts of Vulgar ___ she traced the divergence of Western Romance dialects.
d.diag-1307.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1307.why: 兩獨立子句需分號分隔：; specifically,。 分號 + specifically, 銜接獨立子句。

d.diag-1308.prompt: The superconductor demonstrates zero electrical resistance below critical ___ engineers anticipate revolutionary advances in magnetic levitation transport.
d.diag-1308.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1308.why: 獨立子句連接選 ; accordingly,。 分號 + accordingly, 連接獨立子句。

d.diag-1309.prompt: Botanists collected specimens of rare montane orchids during the ___ dried plant samples were subsequently cataloged in the herbarium archive.
d.diag-1309.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1309.why: 兩獨立主謂結構連接，用分號隔開：monsoon; the。 獨立子句連接選分號 monsoon; the。

d.diag-1310.prompt: The poet discarded the rigid metrical constraints of the Italian ___ she composed free-form verses that captured modern psychological dissonance.
d.diag-1310.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1310.why: 獨立子句連接選 ; instead,。 分號 + instead, 標點選 ; instead,。

d.diag-1311.prompt: Dr. Aris Thorne, a biochemist at the Max Planck ___ received an international award for research on the catalytic properties of ribozymes.
d.diag-1311.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1311.why: a biochemist at the Max Planck Institute 為主詞 Dr. Aris Thorne 的同位語插入語，前面已有逗號，結尾須用逗號成對閉合：Institute,。 正確答案為「Institute,」。

d.diag-1312.prompt: The Hubble Space Telescope, which was deployed into low Earth orbit in ___ revolutionized observational astronomy by providing unobstructed views of the cosmos.
d.diag-1312.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1312.why: 非限定關係子句 which was deployed into... in 1990 需用成對逗號封閉，選 1990,。 關係子句封閉逗號選 1990,。

d.diag-1313.prompt: The newly deciphered clay tablets, inscribed with cuneiform legal codes during the reign of Hammurabi, ___ unprecedented insight into ancient Babylonian jurisprudence.
d.diag-1313.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1313.why: 主詞為複數名詞 tablets，中間有過去分詞片語插入語，主要動詞需用複數現在式 provide。 主謂一致：The clay tablets [修飾語] provide...

d.diag-1314.prompt: The monarch butterfly's multi-generational migration—an extraordinary navigational feat that spans thousands of ___ continues to baffle behavioral biologists.
d.diag-1314.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1314.why: 前面使用了長破折號 (—)，插入語結尾必須使用對稱的長破折號閉合：miles—。 破折號插入語成對使用：miles—。

d.diag-1315.prompt: The restoration of the Gothic cathedral's stained glass windows, a painstaking endeavor overseen by Master Artisan Jean ___ required three decades to complete.
d.diag-1315.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1315.why: 主詞同位語插入語 (a painstaking endeavor overseen by Master Artisan Jean Luc) 結尾需用逗號閉合：Luc,。 同位語插入語逗號閉合選 Luc,。

d.diag-1316.prompt: Ants, which communicate primarily through specialized pheromone ___ coordinate complex foraging behaviors across subterranean supercolonies.
d.diag-1316.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1316.why: 非限定關係子句 which communicate primarily through... trails 結尾需用逗號閉合：trails,。 關係子句成對逗號選 trails,。

d.diag-1317.prompt: The philosopher’s core premise—that human ethical behavior originates from innate empathy rather than calculated ___ challenged the utilitarian tenets of his era.
d.diag-1317.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1317.why: 破折號插入語需對稱閉合：self-interest—。 破折號成對閉合選 self-interest—。

d.diag-1318.prompt: The volcanic archipelago, isolated from the continental mainland for millions of ___ harbors hundreds of endemic floral species found nowhere else on Earth.
d.diag-1318.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1318.why: 過去分詞片語形容詞插入語 isolated from... for millions of years 結尾需用逗號閉合：years,。 分詞插入語成對逗號選 years,。

d.diag-1319.prompt: Professor Evelyn Vance, whose field research in the Kalahari overturned orthodox models of hunter-gatherer ___ delivered the keynote symposium address.
d.diag-1319.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1319.why: 所有格關係子句 whose field research... overturned models of mobility 結尾需逗號閉合：mobility,。 關係子句成對逗號閉合選 mobility,。

d.diag-1320.prompt: The Great Barrier Reef, a delicate marine ecosystem composed of billions of tiny coral ___ faces unprecedented bleaching events due to rising sea temperatures.
d.diag-1320.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1320.why: 同位語 a delicate marine ecosystem composed of... polyps 需逗號閉合：polyps,。 同位語插入語成對逗號選 polyps,。

d.diag-1321.prompt: The geneticist isolated three distinct regulatory proteins—activator, repressor, and ___ mapped their binding sites across the eukaryotic genome.
d.diag-1321.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1321.why: 插入語由破折號開始，列舉完三種蛋白質後需以破折號閉合，再接主要動詞 mapped：inducer—and。 破折號成對插入語：inducer—and mapped...

d.diag-1322.prompt: The expedition traversed the Taklamakan Desert—a hyper-arid expanse of shifting sand dunes ___ water sources were virtually non-existent.
d.diag-1322.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1322.why: 關係副詞 where 修飾前方地點 expanse，子句內部無需逗號打斷，選 where。 關係副詞引導定語子句選 where。

d.diag-1323.prompt: The quantum computing prototype operates at cryogenic temperatures—conditions colder than deep ___ avoid decoherence of its superconducting qubits.
d.diag-1323.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1323.why: 成對破折號閉合插入語，後接不定詞表示目的：space—to。 破折號插入語成對閉合選 space—to。

d.diag-1324.prompt: The novelist’s recurring motifs—alienation, unrequited devotion, and spiritual ___ reflect the profound disillusionment of the post-war era.
d.diag-1324.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1324.why: 主詞與動詞 reflect 之間為破折號成對插入語，結尾選 malaise—。 破折號成對閉合選 malaise—。

d.diag-1325.prompt: The astrophysicist analyzed fast radio bursts—mysterious millisecond-duration pulses of extragalactic ___ origin remains a subject of intense scientific inquiry.
d.diag-1325.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1325.why: whose origin remains... 為修飾 radiation 的關係子句，直接接在名詞後即可；分號或句號會讓關係子句變成殘缺句，whose 後多加逗號則把 whose 與 origin 拆開。 正確答案為「radiation whose」。

d.diag-1326.prompt: The three occupational layers uncovered at the site—Neolithic, Bronze Age, and ___ are each characterized by distinctive ceramic typology.
d.diag-1326.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1326.why: 主詞 The three occupational layers 與動詞 are 之間以破折號插入列舉，結尾須用破折號成對閉合，才能接回主要動詞 are。 正確答案為「Hellenistic—」。

d.diag-1327.prompt: The ancient irrigation system—a subterranean network of gravity-fed aqueducts known as ___ sustained desert agriculture for over two millennia.
d.diag-1327.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1327.why: 主詞與主要謂語動詞 sustained 之間以成對破折號插入，選 qanats—。 破折號閉合同位語選 qanats—。

d.diag-1328.prompt: The migratory birds rely on specific staging wetlands—habitats critically endangered by agricultural ___ complete their transcontinental journey.
d.diag-1328.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1328.why: 破折號成對閉合插入語，後接不定詞 to complete：drainage—to。 破折號閉合後接目的不定詞選 drainage—to。

d.diag-1329.prompt: The Renaissance master’s sfumato technique—the subtle blending of colors and tones without perceptible ___ imparted an ethereal luminescence to his portraits.
d.diag-1329.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1329.why: 主詞與主要動詞 imparted 之間為破折號同位語說明，選 transitions—。 破折號成對閉合選 transitions—。

d.diag-1330.prompt: The economic theorist challenged traditional equilibrium assumptions—axioms predicated on perfect information and unconstrained ___ arguing that cognitive friction dominates markets.
d.diag-1330.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1330.why: 名詞同位語插入語以成對破折號封閉，選 rationality—。 成對破折號閉合選 rationality—。

d.diag-1331.prompt: Beneath the dense forest canopy of the Amazon basin ___ hundreds of unexcavated geoglyphs that challenge assumptions about pre-Columbian urbanism.
d.diag-1331.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1331.why: 倒裝句：地點介系詞片語置於句首，真正主詞為後方的複數名詞 hundreds of unexcavated geoglyphs，動詞使用複數形 lie。 倒裝句主謂一致：主詞為複數 geoglyphs，動詞選 lie。

d.diag-1332.prompt: The identification of migratory flyways and stopover wetlands ___ essential for designing effective multinational conservation treaties.
d.diag-1332.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1332.why: 主詞為單數核心名詞 The identification（辨識確認），後接介系詞片語，謂語動詞使用單數 is。 主謂一致：核心主詞為單數 identification，動詞選 is。

d.diag-1333.prompt: Among the most formidable challenges facing deep-sea submersibles ___ the immense hydrostatic pressure encountered at abyssal depths.
d.diag-1333.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1333.why: 倒裝句：介系詞片語置於句首，真正主詞為後方的單數名詞 pressure，謂語動詞使用單數 is。 倒裝句主謂一致：真正主詞為單數 pressure，動詞選 is。

d.diag-1334.prompt: Neither the historical accuracy of the chronicles nor the linguistic authenticity of the royal decrees ___ in doubt among contemporary medievalists.
d.diag-1334.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1334.why: Neither A nor B 結構，動詞依就近原則 (proximity rule) 與 B 一致：B (authenticity) 為單數，選 is。 就近原則：the linguistic authenticity 為單數，選 is。

d.diag-1335.prompt: Surrounding the ancient temple complex ___ a broad defensive moat engineered to deter hostile incursions.
d.diag-1335.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1335.why: 倒裝句：分詞片語置於句首，真正主詞為後方的單數名詞 a broad defensive moat，動詞用單數 was。 正確答案為「was」。

d.diag-1336.prompt: The discovery of extremophile bacteria thriving in geothermal vents ___ long-standing assumptions about the biological boundaries of life.
d.diag-1336.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1336.why: 主詞為單數名詞 The discovery，後接介系詞片語修飾，謂語動詞使用第三人稱單數 contradicts。 主謂一致：主詞為單數 discovery，動詞選 contradicts。

d.diag-1337.prompt: Hidden within the ice cores retrieved from Greenland glaciers ___ atmospheric air bubbles trapped during the last interglacial period.
d.diag-1337.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1337.why: 倒裝句：真正主詞為後方複數名詞 atmospheric air bubbles，動詞選複數 are。 倒裝句主謂一致：主詞為複數 bubbles，動詞選 are。

d.diag-1338.prompt: A catalog of illuminated manuscripts and liturgical scrolls from the ninth century ___ compiled by the monastery archivists.
d.diag-1338.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1338.why: 核心主詞為單數名詞 A catalog，後接 of... 介系詞片語，謂語動詞使用單數 was。 主謂一致：核心主詞為單數 catalog，動詞選 was。

d.diag-1339.prompt: Embedded within the petrified amber ___ the fossilized antennae of an extinct Cretaceous wasp species.
d.diag-1339.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1339.why: 倒裝句：真正主詞為複數名詞 the fossilized antennae（antenna 的複數為 antennae），動詞使用複數 were。 倒裝句主謂一致：主詞為複數 antennae，動詞選 were。

d.diag-1340.prompt: Neither the high price of platinum catalysts nor the technical volatility of the chemical reaction ___ researchers from developing green hydrogen.
d.diag-1340.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1340.why: Neither... nor... 就近原則：the technical volatility 為單數名詞，動詞選 deters。 就近原則：volatility 為單數，選 deters。

d.diag-1341.prompt: Long before modern plate tectonics theory was formally accepted in the 1960s, Alfred Wegener ___ the continental drift hypothesis in 1912.
d.diag-1341.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1341.why: 動作發生在過去某一時間點 (1960s) 之前，且有 Long before 引導，使用過去完成式 had proposed。 過去完成式：強調發生在過去某動作之前的動作，選 had proposed。
d.diag-1341.topic: Verb Tense & Aspect: Past vs. Past Perfect

d.diag-1342.prompt: By the time the imperial delegation arrived in Samarkand, the resident governor ___ all diplomatic treaties with the visiting Silk Road envoys.
d.diag-1342.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1342.why: By the time + 過去式 (arrived)，主要子句表示在此之前已完成，使用過去完成式 had ratified。 By the time + 過去式，主要子句選過去完成式 had ratified。
d.diag-1342.topic: Verb Tense & Aspect: Past vs. Past Perfect

d.diag-1343.prompt: If the Roman legions ___ their tactical formations during the Battle of Teutoburg Forest, the catastrophic ambush might have been averted.
d.diag-1343.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1343.why: 與過去事實相反的假設語氣：if 子句使用 had + p.p. (had maintained)，主要子句搭配 might have been averted。 與過去事實相反假設：if 子句選 had maintained。
d.diag-1343.topic: Verb Tense & Aspect: Past vs. Past Perfect

d.diag-1344.prompt: Astronomers established that the binary star system ___ orbiting a supermassive black hole for millions of years prior to its eventual tidal disruption.
d.diag-1344.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1344.why: 過去動作 (established) 前持續進行的動作，使用過去完成進行式/完成式 had been。 過去時態呼應選 had been。
d.diag-1344.topic: Verb Tense & Aspect: Past vs. Past Perfect

d.diag-1345.prompt: Prior to the implementation of the clean air accords, industrial chimneys ___ sulfur dioxide into the atmosphere with minimal regulatory oversight.
d.diag-1345.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1345.why: Prior to the implementation... 指出過去某時間點，描述在那之前已發生的動作用過去完成式 had emitted；will emit、have emitted、emit 的時態都與過去背景不符。 正確答案為「had emitted」。
d.diag-1345.topic: Verb Tense & Aspect: Past vs. Past Perfect

d.diag-1346.prompt: Had the emergency containment valve functioned properly, toxic chemical effluent ___ into the municipal watershed.
d.diag-1346.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1346.why: 倒裝省略 If 的過去虛擬假設 (Had S p.p.)，主要子句使用 would not have leaked。 過去虛擬假設主要子句選 would not have leaked。
d.diag-1346.topic: Verb Tense & Aspect: Past vs. Past Perfect

d.diag-1347.prompt: By the dawn of the twentieth century, urbanization and agricultural expansion ___ almost all of the native tallgrass prairie in North America.
d.diag-1347.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1347.why: By + 過去時間點 (dawn of the 20th century)，使用過去完成式 had eradicated。 By + 過去時間點搭配過去完成式 had eradicated。
d.diag-1347.topic: Verb Tense & Aspect: Past vs. Past Perfect

d.diag-1348.prompt: Archaeologists deduced that the subterranean catacombs ___ as ceremonial burial chambers centuries before being converted into military bunkers.
d.diag-1348.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1348.why: 在過去被改建 (being converted) 數個世紀之前已存在，使用過去完成式 had served。 過去更早階段選 had served。
d.diag-1348.topic: Verb Tense & Aspect: Past vs. Past Perfect

d.diag-1349.prompt: If the naval commander ___ the coded cryptographic warning, the fleet could have evaded the devastating submarine torpedo barrage.
d.diag-1349.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1349.why: 與過去相反假設：if 子句選 had decoded。 與過去相反假設條件句選 had decoded。
d.diag-1349.topic: Verb Tense & Aspect: Past vs. Past Perfect

d.diag-1350.prompt: Historical archives confirm that the Renaissance polymath ___ over fifty empirical architectural designs before completing his seminal treatise in 1510.
d.diag-1350.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1350.why: 在 1510 年完成專著之前已完成繪製，使用過去完成式 had drafted。 在過去時間點前已完成動作用 had drafted。
d.diag-1350.topic: Verb Tense & Aspect: Past vs. Past Perfect

d.diag-1351.prompt: Having analyzed thousands of genomic sequences, ___.
options: a conserved protein domain essential for DNA repair was identified by the computational biologists
the identification of a conserved protein domain was achieved
the computational biologists identified a conserved protein domain essential for DNA repair
it was discovered that a protein domain facilitates DNA repair
d.diag-1351.answer: the computational biologists identified a conserved protein domain essential for DNA repair
d.diag-1351.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1351.why: 現在分詞短語 Having analyzed... 的邏輯主詞必須是能主動執行分析動作的「計算生物學家 (computational biologists)」。 分詞修飾語邏輯主詞一致：選 the computational biologists 開頭之選項。

d.diag-1352.prompt: Constructed from interlocking stone blocks without mortar, ___.
options: centuries of severe earthquakes failed to destroy the Inca fortress
the architectural brilliance of the Inca fortress was demonstrated
earthquakes could not dismantle the Inca fortress
the Inca fortress withstood severe earthquakes for centuries
d.diag-1352.answer: the Inca fortress withstood severe earthquakes for centuries
d.diag-1352.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1352.why: 過去分詞短語 Constructed from... 的邏輯主詞必須是被砌築建造的實體建築「印加城堡 (the Inca fortress)」。 過去分詞邏輯主詞選 the Inca fortress。

options: the virologist observed the hexagonal capsid of the novel bacteriophage
the hexagonal capsid of the novel bacteriophage was observed by the virologist
observations of the bacteriophage capsid were carefully recorded
it was possible to discern the hexagonal structure of the virus
d.diag-1353.answer: the virologist observed the hexagonal capsid of the novel bacteriophage
d.diag-1353.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1353.why: Peering through... 的邏輯主詞必須是凝視顯微鏡的人「病毒學家 (the virologist)」。 現在分詞修飾語邏輯主詞選 the virologist。

d.diag-1354.prompt: To accurately measure atmospheric greenhouse gas concentrations, ___.
options: instruments for spectrometry are calibrated before every flight by atmospheric scientists
atmospheric scientists calibrate their airborne spectrometry instruments before every flight
calibration of the airborne spectrometry instruments is required
it is necessary to calibrate airborne spectrometry instruments
d.diag-1354.answer: atmospheric scientists calibrate their airborne spectrometry instruments before every flight
d.diag-1354.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1354.why: 不定詞短語 To accurately measure... 的邏輯主詞必須是執行測量動作的「大氣科學家 (atmospheric scientists)」。 目的不定詞邏輯主詞選 atmospheric scientists。

d.diag-1355.prompt: Although heavily damaged by centuries of maritime corrosion, ___.
options: the divers were astounded by the delicate astronomical inscriptions on the bronze astrolabe
inscriptions on the bronze astrolabe were still legible to the diving team
the bronze astrolabe retained delicate astronomical inscriptions that astounded the divers
it was still possible to read the astronomical markings on the astrolabe
d.diag-1355.answer: the bronze astrolabe retained delicate astronomical inscriptions that astounded the divers
d.diag-1355.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1355.why: Although heavily damaged... 的邏輯受詞/主詞必須是遭受腐蝕的器物「青銅星盤 (the bronze astrolabe)」。 讓步分詞邏輯主詞選 the bronze astrolabe。

d.diag-1356.prompt: After spending decades cataloging indigenous herbal remedies, ___.
options: a monumental compendium on rainforest pharmacopeia was published by the ethnobotanist
the publication of a monumental compendium on herbal remedies occurred
it took decades for the herbal remedies to be compiled into a compendium
the ethnobotanist published a monumental compendium on rainforest pharmacopeia

d.diag-1401.prompt:
The following text is adapted from a scholarly essay on Renaissance courtly culture. Which choice best states the main idea of the text? 
Baldassare Castiglione’s *The Book of the Courtier* (1528) famously introduced the concept of *sprezzatura*—a calculated nonchalance designed to conceal the immense effort underlying athletic and social accomplishments. While twentieth-century critics frequently dismissed this posture as mere superficial vanity, recent cultural historians have recognized *sprezzatura* as an indispensable survival mechanism in the treacherous, hyper-competitive courts of early modern Italy.
options: Recent historical reassessments view *sprezzatura* not as trivial superficiality, but as an essential political and social survival strategy in Renaissance courts.
*The Book of the Courtier* was primarily composed as an athletic training manual for young Italian aristocrats.
Twentieth-century scholars correctly determined that Castiglione's philosophical theories lacked practical utility.
Italian courtly life in the sixteenth century was devoid of political intrigue and social competition.
d.diag-1401.answer: Recent historical reassessments view *sprezzatura* not as trivial superficiality, but as an essential political and social survival strategy in Renaissance courts.
d.diag-1401.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。

d.diag-1402.prompt:
The following text discusses deep-sea hydrothermal ecosystems. Which choice best states the primary claim of the author? 
For decades, marine biologists operated under the assumption that all terrestrial and aquatic food webs were anchored exclusively in solar-driven photosynthesis. However, the 1977 discovery of chemosynthetic bacterial colonies at the Galapagos Rift disproved this dogma. By utilizing hydrogen sulfide emitted from geothermal vents to synthesize organic matter, these extremophiles proved that complex multicellular ecosystems can thrive in perpetual darkness without sunlight.
options: Photosynthesis remains the only viable energetic mechanism capable of sustaining marine fauna.
Hydrothermal vent ecosystems demonstrated that biological life can sustain complex food webs independently of solar energy through chemosynthesis.
Hydrogen sulfide is an inherently toxic compound that precludes the development of multicellular life.
Deep-sea ecosystems were first identified in the Atlantic Ocean during the early nineteenth century.
d.diag-1402.answer: Hydrothermal vent ecosystems demonstrated that biological life can sustain complex food webs independently of solar energy through chemosynthesis.
d.diag-1402.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1402.why: 主旨主張題：打破光合作用唯一論，確立化能合成自主支撐食物網地位。 主旨選項直擊 independent of solar energy 核心。

Which choice best summarizes the central argument of the historian regarding the printing press? 
While popular history credits Johannes Gutenberg's movable type printing press with instantaneously igniting the Protestant Reformation, archival evidence suggests a far more gradual transformation. For the first four decades following its invention, European presses predominantly manufactured traditional Latin liturgical texts and papal indulgences, reinforcing orthodox Catholic ecclesiastical authority rather than destabilizing it.
options: Gutenberg's invention was immediately adopted across Europe to challenge papal authority.
The Protestant Reformation emerged entirely independent of changes in printing technology.
The printing press initially bolstered orthodox religious institutions rather than sparking immediate cultural upheaval.
The printing press was banned by European authorities for several decades after its introduction.
d.diag-1403.answer: The printing press initially bolstered orthodox religious institutions rather than sparking immediate cultural upheaval.
d.diag-1403.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1403.why: 主旨論點：印刷術最初被用來印製拉丁禮儀書與贖罪券，反而鞏固舊有宗教建制 (bolstered orthodox institutions)。 正確答案為「The printing press initially bolstered orthodox religious institutions rather than sparking immediate cultural upheaval.」。

d.diag-1404.prompt:
Which choice best expresses the main theme of the literary critique? 
In Mary Shelley’s *Frankenstein*, the creature’s tragic trajectory is not preordained by inherent biological malevolence; rather, his destructive fury is systematically provoked by universal human revulsion and profound social ostracism. Shelley’s gothic masterpiece thus operates as a poignant indictment of a society that judges morality solely through the superficial prism of physical aesthetics.
options: Mary Shelley argued that scientific innovation inevitably leads to monstrous ethical catastrophes.
The novel depicts the creature as an inherently evil being incapable of emotional vulnerability.
Nineteenth-century British society universally embraced individuals who exhibited anatomical differences.
The creature's violence in *Frankenstein* is a tragic consequence of societal cruelty and physical prejudice rather than innate depravity.
d.diag-1404.answer: The creature's violence in *Frankenstein* is a tragic consequence of societal cruelty and physical prejudice rather than innate depravity.
d.diag-1404.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1404.why: 主旨句：悲劇根源在於社會殘酷與外貌偏見 (societal cruelty and physical prejudice)。 主旨選項精準歸納 consequence of societal cruelty rather than innate depravity。

d.diag-1405.prompt:
Which choice best captures the central premise of the economic study? 
Urban economists have long debated whether high housing costs in major metropolitan hubs restrict regional economic dynamism. Examining thirty years of municipal labor data, Dr. Sarah Rossi demonstrates that prohibitive housing prices directly choke off internal geographic mobility. Workers can no longer afford to migrate to high-productivity cities, thereby dampening national aggregate productivity and exacerbating regional economic divergence.
options: Exorbitant urban housing costs diminish overall national economic productivity by restricting the geographic mobility of labor.
High-productivity cities automatically experience lower housing costs due to increased supply.
Internal migration in modern economies has accelerated irrespective of local residential real estate costs.
Regional economic divergence is solely caused by international trade imbalances rather than domestic factors.
d.diag-1405.answer: Exorbitant urban housing costs diminish overall national economic productivity by restricting the geographic mobility of labor.
d.diag-1405.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1405.why: 主旨：高房價阻礙勞動力流動並損害總體生產力 (diminish productivity by restricting mobility)。 主旨選項對應 Exorbitant housing costs diminish productivity...

d.diag-1406.prompt:
Which choice best states the primary claim of the architectural historian? 
While mid-century modernist architecture was ostensibly dedicated to egalitarian functionalism, in practice its sweeping urban renewal projects frequently devastated vibrant working-class neighborhoods. By prioritizing vehicular throughput and monumental scale over pedestrian-friendly streetscapes, modernist planners inadvertently dismantled the intricate social tapestries that sustained urban communities.
options: Modernist architects universally succeeded in designing equitable and socially vibrant metropolitan environments.
Modernist urban renewal often undermined community social cohesion despite its professed egalitarian ideals.
Mid-century urban planners prioritized pedestrian pathways over automotive transportation infrastructure.
Egalitarian functionalism was first conceived as an ancient Roman architectural doctrine.
d.diag-1406.answer: Modernist urban renewal often undermined community social cohesion despite its professed egalitarian ideals.
d.diag-1406.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1406.why: 主旨：現代主義規劃侵蝕了社區凝聚力 (undermined community social cohesion)。 主旨選項對應 Modernist renewal undermined community cohesion...

d.diag-1407.prompt:
Which choice best summarizes the central idea of the evolutionary biology passage? 
Biologists long regarded sexual dimorphism in avian plumage as a straightforward product of female mate choice selecting for male ornamentation. However, recent comparative genomic studies reveal that female birds frequently shed bright ancestral coloration to evade predators while nesting. Thus, female camouflage, rather than male ostentation alone, represents a primary evolutionary driver of sexual dimorphism.
options: Male birds developed vibrant plumage exclusively to frighten competing male rivals away from nesting sites.
Female birds lack the genetic capacity to express complex pigment patterns in their plumage.
Avian sexual dimorphism frequently evolved through female camouflage adaptations for nesting survival rather than male ornamentation alone.
Predation pressure in avian ecosystems affects male and female birds with identical ecological severity.
d.diag-1407.answer: Avian sexual dimorphism frequently evolved through female camouflage adaptations for nesting survival rather than male ornamentation alone.
d.diag-1407.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1407.why: 主旨：雌鳥求生偽裝亦為二型性演化驅動力 (female camouflage adaptations for nesting survival)。 主旨選項對應 Avian sexual dimorphism evolved through female camouflage...

d.diag-1408.prompt:
Which choice best expresses the main argument regarding merchant guilds? 
Far from serving as rigid monopolies that stifled economic innovation, early modern merchant guilds provided essential institutional frameworks for contract enforcement and commercial conflict resolution. By guaranteeing quality standards and reducing information asymmetry across distant trading hubs, guilds actually lowered transaction costs and catalyzed cross-border commercial integration.
options: Merchant guilds were outlawed across Western Europe due to their anti-competitive price-fixing practices.
Early modern European merchants operated entirely without formalized legal or commercial institutions.
Guild regulations systematically prevented technological innovation in maritime navigation.
Merchant guilds facilitated long-distance trade integration by establishing enforceable commercial trust and lowering transaction costs.

d.diag-1408.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。

d.diag-1409.prompt:
Which choice best reflects the primary thesis of the neuroscience essay? 
Contemporary neuroscientists increasingly view the human brain not as a passive receiver of sensory inputs, but as an active 'prediction engine.' Through Bayesian predictive processing, the cerebral cortex continuously generates internal models of the external world, updating its hypotheses only when encountering surprising sensory prediction errors.
options: The brain functions as an active predictive system that continuously anticipates sensory inputs and updates its internal models.
Sensory organs process external environmental data without any top-down modulation from the cerebral cortex.
Human perception is entirely determined by passive reflex arcs that bypass the central nervous system.
Bayesian predictive models are incapable of explaining basic neurological sensory processing.

d.diag-1409.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
d.diag-1409.why: 主旨：大腦功能為持續預期感官輸入的主動預測系統 (active predictive system)。 主旨選項對應 brain functions as an active predictive system...

d.diag-1410.prompt:
Which choice best summarizes the central claim of the political philosopher? 
In *The Human Condition*, Hannah Arendt warns that the encroachment of private consumerist concerns into the public realm has degraded genuine political engagement. By reducing citizenship to mere economic stewardship and administrative management, modern liberal democracies risk forfeiting the capacity for authentic collective deliberation and transformative political action.
options: Arendt advocates for the total elimination of public institutions in favor of private market solutions.
Modern societies diminish the vital political realm by reducing civic participation to economic administration.
Economic prosperity automatically guarantees robust democratic participation and civic virtue.
Ancient Greek city-states suffered from an excessive focus on consumerist and commercial pursuits.
d.diag-1410.answer: Modern societies diminish the vital political realm by reducing civic participation to economic administration.
d.diag-1410.hint: 先判斷這題考的是用字、轉折、標點還是文意，再回到句子裡找證據。
